description:
Hi! My name is Aashni Aggarwal, and I am studying in 9th grade in India. I have special interest in the fields of Geology, Planetary Science, and Space Exploration. I would describe myself as a creative and passionate person, who has an interest in creating new things.

For the NASA space apps challenge, I combined my interests in various fields to develop an optical and topographic terrain map for the Martian Jezero Crater region.
